Marketing Data Analyst - Fernhollow Foods

About the role
Fernhollow is a regional grocery chain growing its marketing analytics function. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Analyse campaign performance
- Build dashboards
- Design and evaluate A/B tests

Requirements
- SQL
- Python for analysis
- Tableau
- A/B testing
- Presenting insights to stakeholders

Nice to have
- dbt

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
